description: Create a NEW account in one call, no email code: email + accept_terms=true (the owner agrees to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy). Returns an API key and signs this chat in. If the email already has an account, use sign_in.

accept_terms.description: must be true: https://www.hokuhost.com/terms and https://www.hokuhost.com/privacy

email.description: the owner's email; domain, receipt and registry emails go there

key_name.description: optional label for the key, e.g. the assistant name

name: create_account
